summary: Verified countdown card bug fix. Numbers are static (animationName='none'), font-size ~47px (large), grid does not overflow card, all labels visible, no console errors, dashboard renders all cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Countdown card fix verified: .countdown-num animationName='none', fontSize 47.26px, no overflow, values stable over 3s observation. Dashboard renders all cards (Countdown, Journey, My Tasks, Study Log, Welcome, Quote, Mock Test Progress, Test Planner, Daily Agenda). Only React Router future flag warnings in console (non-breaking).
rca of the issue: Previously the Unit sub-component was defined inline inside render and used a keyed span with .countdown-flip animation, causing remount+re-animation each render. Fix moved Unit to module scope and removed animation class/keyframes.
